prompt:
ContextCartographer: Assess change impact — Change: New EU CSRD sustainability reporting directive effective January 2026, Scope: Affects all EU operations and supply chain, Standards Impacted: ISO 14001 (environmental aspects), ISO 9001 (customer requirements), Actions Needed: Gap assessment, update context of organization, identify new interested party requirements

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- changeId (string): unique identifier for the change
- description (string): detailed description of the item
- effectiveDate (string): date when the document becomes effective
- scope (string): scope of the change or audit
- impactedStandards (string): standards impacted by this change
- actionsRequired (string): actions required in response
- priority (string): priority level for addressing this item
- owner (string): person responsible for the objective or item
- assessmentStatus (string): current status of the assessment

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
